column1: # The standard host and rewriter run this build; SHN! resources are read by the shared shader splitter.
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk0 (C / libc), subsdk1 (C / libc)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 9216 MB heap region
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares no system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# The scripts size the framebuffer by the operation mode (hires 0: console 1920x1080, handheld 1280x720; main+0x10f328 -> 0x11ff04 / 0x11ff1c, built at 0x1218cc),
# and the window crop is the smallest of vi's BufferMaxResolution cap, oe::GetDefaultDisplayResolution and the window (main+0x11fde4). The graphics scale is only a script
# property (graphicsScale, main+0x10f0d0). Both modes present 1920x1080 (on Switch 2 oe answers the 1080p screen in handheld too); they differ in the DLSS input:
# Docked is the game's own start (races: DLSS 960x540 -> 1920x1080), Handheld its handheld mode (races: DLSS 640x360 -> 1920x1080; Odin 3: GPU about 13.8 vs 14.0 ms).
# A row's size is the launcher's choice (one row per size), not what this game draws: 1280x720 names the handheld choice
# Android: the game's DLSS (NVN2) runs on vka's stand-in, Snapdragon GSR2 3-pass (vka_dlss.c); the launcher's Upscaler row offers its modes (GSR 2, FSR 1, FSR 3.1,
# Bilinear) with Motion clarity (DM_VK_GSR2_CLARITY) and Temporal sharpness (DM_VK_DLSS_SHARP), in Game settings and the in-game panel. The stand-in keeps the colour's
# alpha, which this game composites its 3D layer over the menu UI by
